newsitem.title: USA: Delta seen in sole-supplier deal with Boeing.
newsitem.headline: Delta seen in sole-supplier deal with Boeing.

text.p: Delta Air Lines Inc is expected to award a multi-year contract to Boeing Co on Thursday, making the Seattle-based manufacturer its sole supplier, industry sources said.
The move, on the heels of last year's pact between AMR Corp's American Airlines and Boeing, would mark a shift toward airlines committing to a single manufacturer.

"Historically, airlines have been reluctant to go with a single source because they were afraid of ceding pricing control to one supplier," said Wolfgang Demisch, an aerospace analyst with BT Securities. "But now, they lock in pricing relationships for the long-term."
Having a uniform fleet allows airlines to substantially reduce maintenance and training costs. The aircraft manufacturers also benefit from having a steady, predictable order supply, analysts said.
The manufacturers "get promises of future buying behavior in exchange for substantial concessions today," Demisch said.
Delta said will hold a news conference at 1300 EST/1800 GMT at Hartsfield Atlanta International Airport to announce its long-awaited aircraft order. Delta declined to elaborate.
Boeing could not be reached for comment.
Delta has said it planned to replace its aging fleet of L-1011s and has been exploring the purchase of several other aircraft.
Delta had been in lengthy discussion with both Boeing and Airbus Industrie, but some analysts speculated that Airbus was never a serious option due to past problems with some Airbus planes.

In 1991, Delta acquired certain aircraft and European routes from the former Pan Am, and experienced problems with Pan Am's aging Airbus fleet. This may have tilted Delta against making a substantial Airbus order, some airline analysts said.
While Boeing appears to have won this round, Airbus is not knocked out, analysts said. Boeing has the lead in global marketshare, but Airbus continues to land crucial contracts.
Airbus landed a tentative agreement with US Airways Group Inc last year, while it also is in talks with Northwest Airlines Corp for major order.
